_meta.purpose: Experimental Tm benchmark to validate the tool's nearest-neighbour Tm model INDEPENDENTLY. Each oligo must have an EXPERIMENTALLY MEASURED duplex Tm (UV-melting / DSC) under stated salt conditions.
provenance_fixes_2026-07-03: REMOVED the two previous entries whose tm_experimental_c was actually the tool's OWN predicted Tm (circular; would give MAE~0). Never validate a model against its own output.

SEPARATED provenance: sequence_source_doi (where the sequence comes from) vs tm_source_doi (where the measured Tm comes from). The old file attached the Chen-2005 DOI to a Tm value that did not come from Chen 2005.
CORRECTED recorded tool salt conditions to match backend/algorithm/constants.py (Mg2+ = 1.5 mM = P3_DEFAULT_DV_CONC, NOT 3.0 mM).
Added the two proper independent experimental datasets (Owczarzy 2004 sodium; Owczarzy 2008 magnesium/dNTP).
honesty_rules: Only entries with verified==true enter MAE/bias. Do NOT invent or estimate Tm values.
tm_experimental_c must be a MEASURED value transcribed from tm_source_doi tables/supplement (or measured in-lab), NOT a predicted/tool value.
Record the exact salt conditions of the measurement; if they differ from the tool's, note it (Owczarzy 2008 gives the correction to reconcile Mg2+/monovalent).
CRITICAL_do_not_confuse: This benchmark is for OLIGO/PRIMER DUPLEX Tm (what the tool predicts for a primer). It is NOT the amplicon melting-curve (product) Tm that qPCR papers report as 'Tm ~78C'. Do not mix the two.

Do NOT validate the SantaLucia-1998-based model using the SantaLucia 1998 dataset itself (circular; it is the training set). Owczarzy 2004/2008 are INDEPENDENT UV-melting datasets and are the correct choice.

tool_salt_conditions.note: From constants.py: P3_DEFAULT_MV_CONC=50, P3_DEFAULT_DV_CONC=1.5, P3_DEFAULT_DNTP_CONC=0.8, P3_DEFAULT_DNA_CONC=200. Keep in sync with constants.py.

recommended_datasets: [Owczarzy04] Owczarzy R et al. 'Effects of sodium ions on DNA duplex oligomers: improved predictions of melting temperatures.' Biochemistry 2004;43(12):3537-3554. PMID 15035624. DOI 10.1021/bi034621r -- 92 DNA duplex oligomers, UV-melting, [Na+] 69 mM to 1.02 M; independent-set avg error ~1.6 C.

[Owczarzy08] Owczarzy R et al. 'Predicting stability of DNA duplexes in solutions containing magnesium and monovalent cations.' Biochemistry 2008;47(19):5336-5353. PMID 18422348. DOI 10.1021/bi702363u -- Mg2+/K+/Na+/Tris/dNTP melting datasets; PCR-relevant (1.5-5 mM Mg2+, 20-100 mM monovalent). MATCHES the tool Mg2+/dNTP regime.

[SL98/SL04] SantaLucia 1998 (DOI 10.1073/pnas.95.4.1460) and SantaLucia & Hicks 2004 (DOI 10.1146/annurev.biophys.32.110601.141800) provide the NN PARAMETERS the tool uses -- do NOT use as a validation set (circular).
_meta.how_to_populate: Transcribe individual oligos (sequence + measured Tm + exact [Na+]/[Mg2+]) from the Owczarzy 2004 sodium series and Owczarzy 2008 magnesium series. Aim for >=15-20 oligos spanning length 8-30 nt and GC 20-80%. Prefer Owczarzy 2008 entries near the tool conditions (1.5 mM Mg2+). Set verified=true only after transcription is checked against the paper.
